verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform that uses AI agents, so a policy on whether customer data trains AI models is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training opt-outs, data-usage policies, or contractual no-training commitments. The AI agent pages describe what the agents do, not how customer data is used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
